target.title: fix(plugin-sdk): bound Anthropic Vertex ADC credential read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`canReadAnthropicVertexAdc` in `src/plugin-sdk/anthropic-vertex-auth-presence.ts` reads the entire GCP ADC credentials file via unbounded `fs.readFileSync(credentialsPath, "utf8")` solely to check whether the file is readable — its contents are discarded. The path comes from `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` (an external, user-controlled env var) or the default gcloud ADC path, so a misconfigured or oversized file triggers an unbounded memory read just to report `true`.

The provider-local copy of this exact logic in `extensions/anthropic-vertex/region.ts` was already bounded with `tryReadSecretFileSync` + a 1 MiB limit in #109260 ("reject oversized credential files in remaining readers"). This standalone plugin-sdk preflight helper is a duplicate that sweep missed.

This PR mirrors the region.ts bound: replace the unbounded `readFileSync` with `tryReadSecretFileSync(..., { maxBytes: 1 MiB, rejectHardlinks: false })`, wrapped in `try/catch` (the helper throws `FsSafeError` on oversize) so an oversized credential file is rejected instead of slurped into memory. Presence-check semantics are unchanged for normal-sized files.

## Evidence

Proof script run with Node 22 + tsx (`hasAnthropicVertexAvailableAuth` against real temp files):

```
ADC read bound: 1048576 bytes (1024 KiB)

[1] Small ADC file (normal credential):
    size:  32 bytes
    NEW hasAnthropicVertexAvailableAuth: true  (expected true)

[2] Oversized ADC file (2 MiB, exceeds bound):
    size:  2097153 bytes
    OLD unbounded readFileSync:           true  (read entire 2097153-byte file, returned true)
    NEW hasAnthropicVertexAvailableAuth: false  (expected false: bound rejects oversize)

RESULT: normal read preserved = true; oversized rejected by bound = true; old code read it fully = true
PASS
```

- Normal-sized ADC file → still detected (`true`), no regression.
- Oversized 2 MiB ADC file → rejected (`false`) by the 1 MiB bound; the old unbounded code read the entire file and returned `true`.
- Existing unicode-path test still passes; preflight test still asserts no `existsSync` preflight; added a regression test for oversize rejection.
- Local precheck: vitest 3/3 green, `tsgo:core:test` clean, oxlint clean.
